about: Dated corrections and additions to library sourcing, applied by tools/merge_modules.py after the library agents' rows (those files stay verbatim). Every 'set' names the snapshot it was read from (library/references/index.json has its sha256).

Variant '3 Pin' (sku 083-3P-2mm-F-Wire): Rs 12.00 excl. GST (Rs 14.16 incl.), 358 available to sell; 30 cm; open other end. Read from the page's variant data on 2026-11-01; the earlier note's single Rs 9 price is the 2-pin variant.

DIFFERENT part from the CNC Kitchen reference: the vendor drawing shows 3.5 mm OD x 4.00 mm (title says 4.5 mm), pack of 10. It is its own library row, INSERT_HEATSET_M2_5X4_MEC8005, which is what normalize buys.
Rs 79.99 is the M2.5 x 8 variant (MEC7001-M2.5/8), pack of 10. This set row is the CAD geometry reference only; normalize buys one row per length (SCREW_M2_5X5/X8/X12_SHCS_A2, SCREW_M2X6_SHCS_A2).

module_fields.why: REVIEW-1 MAJ-24 / MIN-25 (integration, 2026-11-01): the QR + serial label is unique per device, so the factory prints and applies it and packs the device; it is a factory make-to-drawing row, priced from the blueprint planning range (no label stock or printer has been chosen)

factory_make.what: Print the device ID label (serial + QR to the device record) on 50 x 25 mm thermal-transfer polyester stock, apply it in the base recess and pack the device.
steps: read the serial provisioned into flash at factory test
print serial + QR on 50 x 25 mm thermal-transfer polyester label stock (resin ribbon)
apply the label in the printed recess on the base
pack the device (bag, box, insert, quick-start card)
factory_make.test: scan the QR and check it reads the same serial as the device's factory self-test line
factory_make.price_basis: blueprint catalog row 50 planning range INR 30-150 (label stock, ribbon and packing kit not yet chosen; not a quote)
